mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5% for three consecutive months, monetary policy becomes sufficiently restrictive to depress credit conditions and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and unemployment rate move in opposite directions for three months (e.g., FEDFUNDS rises while UNRATE falls), monetary policy is likely restrictive relative to labor market conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE move in opposite directions for 3 months
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
